address: 2 Mu 7, Baan Sri Than, Nai Meuang, Meuang Khon Kaen, Khon Kaen, 40000, Thailand
bio: Kaprao E Jae serves an impressively consistent and flavoursome pad kaprao – a classic featuring holy basil stir fried with either shrimp, squid, beef, Isan sausage, pork offal or even duck. Each aromatic dish is served with a fierce mix of garlic and fresh and dried chillies....
